name: K10 Colorado
_v070: Dali-painting fix. The inter-track world was built by sampling REAL 3DEP across FABRICATED compressed positions -> fake 190 m climbs, a road-vs-grass 60 m split (my v0.6 reconcile then tied tracks to the low grass, opening 60 m cliffs at every connector), a reservoir floating at 23 km (Z/height arg swap), and a 1.5 km mountain wall 4 km from Aspen. v0.7 replaces all inter-track 3DEP with ONE synthetic gentle west-rising plane (scenery.elevation.synthetic): tracks seated on it, connectors ride it, ground conforms -> connectors meet tracks AT GRADE, ~26 m total spread. Water arg swap fixed + fictional reservoirs off. Mountains pushed to ~47/60 km, capped ~440 m. Power poles/wires/streetlights culled across the map. Each track keeps its OWN real internal relief.
_v060: Template-quality pass (superseded by v0.7 elevation rework): corkscrew level-deck + grade cap, all-dry ground, guardrails removed, grass/scatter cleared under tracks.
author: prodrive-ac-builder
_about: Unified Colorado motorsports cruise. ONE kml-network mesh (san-diego-cruise precedent) that stitches the Sand Creek Raceway street loop (Commerce City) to the IMI Motorsports road course (Dacono) via a real main-road corridor up Colorado Blvd -> US-85 -> CO-52, so you can drive between them. Each track is an AC layout (its own spawn) over the single shared kn5. More Colorado complexes get added as further layouts. Faded Front Range backdrop to the true west; buildings/water/hills dressing along the corridor.

location._note: Primary anchor (Sand Creek pit spur) — also the default freeroam spawn + network clip centre. Per-track spawns are set in layouts[].spawn.

source._doc: kml-network = merge N KML LineString sources into ONE deduped road graph (scripts/gps/network.py). Vertices within network.snap_grid_m collapse into shared nodes, so the corridor auto-junctions onto the Sand Creek loop and the IMI course where they touch. All three files are lon/lat LineStrings; IMI's is converted from its aerial centerline.geojson.

origin._doc: SHARED origin so detailed merged tracks (Sand Creek, IMI) build in the SAME frame as the network connectors -> one kn5. elev_m is a floor below the lowest track.

network._doc: Graph-build knobs (scripts/gps/network.py + classify.py). clip_radius_m:0 keeps the FULL ~28.7 km Sand Creek -> Dacono span (do NOT clip). class_widths_m sets ribbon width per OSM road class voted by classify.py.

scenery._doc: Per-class scatter + landmarks read by build_network_env.py / build_network_mesh.py. corridor_margin_m keeps scatter clear of every road edge.

elevation._doc: The inter-track world is FICTIONAL (compressed fabricated positions), so sampling real 3DEP across it manufactured fake ~150 m climbs + garbage cells (23 km sky-water). synthetic:true -> network_elev + merge_detailed use scripts/elevation/synthetic_field.py: ONE gentle plane rising west_rise_per_km_m toward the far-west mountains (+x = true west under mirror). Each track's mean deck is seated on this plane, connectors ride it, the ground conforms to it -> connectors meet tracks at grade, ~26 m total spread not 190 m. Each track keeps its OWN internal relief (built in its own frame).

scenery._dry_only_doc: Colorado high plains = dry chaparral. Disables the 1LAWN green-turf classifier so ALL ground tiles are 1GRASS (ground_dry_diffuse.jpg, tan dirt) — cohesive with Sand Creek's dry ground, no suburban-green patches.

freeway_furniture._furniture_doc: SRP freeway guardrails + overhead gantries read wrong on open Colorado plains (user: 'guardrails look like shit') and clashed with the kerbed race tracks. Off for cohesion; sparse light poles stay.

mountains._doc: Faded Front Range backdrop, far to the true WEST. NOT modeled terrain — layered double-sided ridge curtains placed by REAL longitude (dlon<0 = west of origin) through the mirror-aware projector, so they land at true west and the sun sets behind them. Ported into build_network_env.py from build_env.py. MUST stay OUT of GrassFX OCCLUDING_MESHES (whole-PC freeze).
mountains._backdrop_doc: FAINT, LOW, FAR. dlon -0.55/-0.70 lands the ridges at local X ~47/60 km (was 17/24) so the nearest is ~34 km from the westernmost track (Aspen at +12.8 km), not a 4 km wall. Peaks capped ~270/440 m (was 1517). base_y tucks the skirt below sightline; distance + CSP aerial haze do the rest.

water_bodies._doc: Named water discs (build_network_env.py). enabled:false for K10 — these reservoirs are fictional dressing over compressed positions and (via a Z/height arg swap, now fixed) were floating at up to 23 km. Off until they add value.

buildings._doc: Procedural building placement in the network path (ported from build_env.py). near_lap_m keeps buildings within this of a road; off_road_m rejects any on the pavement; warehouse_area_m2 splits big industrial from commercial façades.

banking._doc: PPIR D-oval banking (build_network_mesh). Any edge vertex in the annulus [r_in_m,r_out_m] of the centre is rolled by bank_deg (ramped 25m at each annulus edge), so the OVAL ring banks while the flat INFIELD road course inside it (radius <190m) stays flat.

terrain._doc: DEM extent auto-computed from the network's own vertex bbox + margin (network_elev.py). Near-road elevation masking (network_elev) + a 5% grade cap keep the wide compressed-spine map fast to sample and free of narnia hills. The dramatic Front Range comes from scenery.mountains, not terrain.

layouts.name: Sand Creek Raceway
layouts._doc: Spawn at the Sand Creek street loop (Commerce City). Drive the loop or head north up Colorado Blvd toward IMI.

layouts.name: IMI Motorsports Complex
layouts._doc: Spawn at the IMI road course (Dacono). Drive the course or head south back down to Sand Creek.

layouts.name: Second Creek Raceway
layouts._doc: Spawn at the recreated Second Creek Raceway (closed ~2005, former site 17010 E 88th Ave). Traced from the vintage track map, georeferenced to the real site, 1.7-mi lap. Reached from the corridor via second_creek_spur (N Buckley Rd -> E 96th -> E 88th).

layouts.name: High Plains Raceway
layouts._doc: Compressed I-70 spine EAST. 2.55-mi road course traced from the aerial. Reached via to_high_plains (representative I-70 east). Placed on gentle plains.

layouts.name: Aspen Racing Club
layouts._doc: Compressed I-70 spine WEST toward the mountains. Club road course (Woody Creek), de-rotated from the phone shot. Reached via to_aspen (representative I-70 west) on a GENTLE grade up (grade cap 5%).

layouts.name: Pikes Peak Int'l Raceway
layouts._doc: Compressed I-25 spine SOUTH. D-shaped BANKED oval (scenery.banking annulus) + flat infield road course. Reached via to_ppir (representative I-25 south).

lighting._doc: presets = time-of-day templates. grassfx:false — a ~29 km network of grass tiles as a GrassFX occlusion field freezes the PC (keep OFF on big maps). mirror_sun handles the sunset-in-the-east bug from mirror_x (see scripts/lighting/csp_config.py); the exact correction is finalized after an in-game check.

light_pollution._note: Denver metro glow to the south/southwest
